verdict.rationale: Several signals point to a hosted Omnara service. Pricing contrasts free self-hosting and free bring-your-own-keys with a paid tier, and a community member mentions a $20/month plan. Agents launch via the dashboard, REST API, CLI, or SDK, and can run 'or [on] a machine you connect,' which implies a default managed runtime. However, no evidence explicitly describes an Omnara-operated cloud execution environment or what it manages. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of managed cloud agent execution, hosted-tier specifics (limits, regions, scaling), and independent hands-on confirmation of running agents on Omnara's infrastructure.
